A different, currently-unused code path (ExtractorOLE.Old.Excel.ExcelExtractor) was fixed for this exact gap on the not-yet-merged branch for task T-02637847, but that class is not referenced by ServiceRegistration/MainExtractor, so its fix does not (by itself) make this sample detectable through the real extraction pipeline. expectedSubfiles above use ExtractionHelper's embedded_object_N naming/index scheme (the path that actually needs the WorksheetPart scan added) so this entry is ready to flip to detectable:true once that scan is added there, mirroring the fix already applied to the pptx slide scan in this same task.
